deploy-bot: :warning: Release 2026.03.12 - candidate v2.14.0 blocked by security gate: vuln-scan found 1 CRITICAL / 3 HIGH. Scan ID: scan-9f3a. Action: HOLD. See https://scans.internal/redwood/scan-9f3a

marta: Ugh, I think those are false positives from the scanner update. I ran the same image locally and only saw 1 MEDIUM. @samir can you confirm?

samir: Looking now. Scanner version 2.7.1 introduced a new heuristic that flags a signature in our internal base image as HIGH. Likely FP.

alex.k: If we can pin the base image digest for this release and produce a signed SBOM, security may allow an exception during today's change window. @priya ?

priya: We can consider exception but need mitigation. Requirements: 1) pin image digest in manifest, 2) generate SBOM and sign it, 3) create a short risk acceptance with owner and rollback plan. If those exist, I can approve a limited rollout in the 14:00-15:00 UTC change window. :+1:

devon: how long to pin & regen sbom? can we do it within 30m?

samir: yes. Steps: `docker pull ghcr.io/rw/base:2026-03-10@sha256:abcd1234ef...` then update k8s image/tag to `@sha256:abcd1234ef...` and run `syft -o json . > sbom.json && cosign sign sbom.json`. I'll push a PR.

marta: I'll prep the PR and release notes change. We'll add an explicit note about the temporary pin and link to the triage ticket.

deploy-bot: Note: Automated policy will re-run vuln scan after image digest change. Re-scan scheduled on PR merge.

priya: Once PR is merged and SBOM signed, post the ticket in #security-approvals and ping me. I'll add the approval comment. Also we need a rollback step defined (how to revert to original tag).

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/2145 - contains pinned digest + sbom + rollback steps. Tagging @priya @alex.k

priya: Reviewed quickly — OK to approve for canary up to 10% during 14:00-15:00 UTC with immediate rollback if any new alerts. I'll post formal approval in security-approvals.

marta: great, merging now. release notes updated. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Merge detected, CI triggered. Re-scan started (scan-9f3a-recheck).

deploy-bot: Re-scan result: 0 CRITICAL / 0 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM. Gate cleared. Scheduling rollout in 14:00 change window.
